title: Externally measured paired coding agent runs
description: Supply both baseline and contextpro runs for the same taskId, pairId, and model. Include the full task (prompt/tool schemas, tool results, reasoning/output) in provider usage. Prices are supplied by the evaluator; the benchmark does not assume current model pricing. Negative differences are valid when ContextPro costs more. Task success must be independently evaluated against the same acceptance criteria for both variants.

cachedInputTokens.description: Subset of inputTokens served from cache; never add again to inputTokens.

reasoningTokens.description: Only when explicitly reported by provider; document whether included in outputTokens.
